parameters.title: Filter spectral data with a single filter
parameters.label: Filter (smooth) spectral data with a single filter: moving-average, gauss, savitzky-golay or LOWESS; or compare several and select one interactively.

parameter.hint: The root fp of the project
The dataframe to use as input, raw = original spectra, previous = the latest saved parquet file(s), or state the name of the parquet file with spectra derived from earlier step(s) to use as input.

The filter to apply: a filter parameter set name (moving-average, gauss, savitzky-golay, lowess or a custom set) or the path (relative to the project root, .json optional) to a filter JSON file; select = compare the filters in filter_array and choose interactively which one to apply; none = no filter.
Only used when filter_fp is select: the filters to compare, each a filter parameter set name or a path (relative to the project root, .json optional) to a filter JSON file.
Optional user extension (1-6 letters, digits or -) added to the file suffix after a hashtag, e.g. .ma5#12321, to tell apart outputs with settings the suffix does not show.
Colour ramp for plotting spectra: a matplotlib colormap name, or default = the spectra_plot parameter set (ml_setting, "jet").
